EW.name: Extinct in the Wild
EW.description: Survives only in captivity or cultivation.

CR.name: Critically Endangered
CR.description: Extremely high risk of extinction in the wild.

EN.name: Endangered
EN.description: Very high risk of extinction in the wild.

VU.name: Vulnerable
VU.description: High risk of extinction in the wild.

NT.name: Near Threatened
NT.description: Likely to become threatened in the near future.

DD.name: Data Deficient
DD.description: Not enough information to assess risk.

NE.name: Not Evaluated
NE.description: Not yet assessed against the IUCN criteria.

threatenedHelp: Threatened = Critically Endangered, Endangered or Vulnerable

awareness.title: Ecosystem services
awareness.body: Healthy ecosystems purify water, pollinate crops, protect coasts and store carbon — services worth trillions of dollars every year.

awareness.title: Bangladesh's natural shield
awareness.body: The Sundarbans mangroves reduce the impact of cyclones and storm surges for millions of people living along the coast.

awareness.title: Extinction is forever
awareness.body: Once a species is lost, its genes, its role in nature and its story are gone for good. Prevention is the only cure.

awareness.title: Conservation works
awareness.body: Protected areas, anti-poaching patrols and community stewardship have brought tigers, pandas and humpback whales back from the brink.
